GUIDED TUTORIAL

Build a Higher-Timeframe Structure Map

Create a repeatable structure map using confirmed swings, continuation breaks and potential shifts.

TUTORIAL MATERIALS
  • One completed futures chart with at least Daily, 1H and 5M views
  • A written swing and candle-close rule
  • A replay or screenshot tool

Track prerequisites: entry-models-execution, futures-contract-roll-risk

01

WORKFLOW

Follow the practice sequence

  1. Step 1

    Choose one instrument and one completed date. Record the contract/continuous symbol, expiry convention, chart feed and timezone.

  2. Step 2

    On Daily and 1H, mark only swings that satisfy one preselected pivot rule. Do not use a future-known turning point before it is confirmed.

  3. Step 3

    Identify the latest relevant break. Label BOS only when the predeclared level and wick/body rule are met.

  4. Step 4

    If studying a possible reversal, record the prior short-term swing, the opposing break and whether displacement accompanies it. Keep MSS distinct from a continuation BOS.

  5. Step 5

    Move to 5M only after the higher-timeframe map is saved. Record what lower-timeframe information refines the map and what does not change it.

02

DELIVERABLE

What to create

A three-timeframe chart pack with five annotated pivots, one candidate BOS/MSS decision and a written invalidation/no-trade note.
